en.content:
Load the structure (story/scene breakdown) into TapNow Agent, then generate it in 30-second segments with Seedance2.5 to create a long-form animation

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] Process:
1. Hand-draw the character designs → turn them into a character sheet with ChatGPT
2. Use Fable5 as a sounding board to decide the structure
3. Load the structure from step 2 into TapNow Agent and generate it with Seedance2.5 in 30-second segments
4. Create the BGM with ElevenLabs’ video-to-music tool
5. Edit in DaVinci
